summary: The note describes Zero-Gravity Dance, a youth-driven trend that emerged as private space travel became mainstream after September 2023. It follows teens like Ellie Tran and Jonah Martinez, the AstroGroove studio, GyroGears suits, competitions, and VR versions. It also covers the cultural meaning of the trend and its adoption by educational institutions, which links the arts with STEM.
one_line: Zero-Gravity Dance, sparked by a viral 2023 space-flight video, is becoming a teen-led art form with studios, competitions, VR versions and academic recognition.
key_facts: Private space travel has been becoming more mainstream since September 2023, enabling the Zero-Gravity Dance trend.
17-year-old Ellie Tran went viral with a choreographed routine filmed aboard the commercial Space-Xperience flight on October 6, 2023.
The hashtag #ZeroGravityDance spread across social media, particularly TikTok.
17-year-old Jonah Martinez predicts dance academies will include zero-gravity choreography and is preparing for his first suborbital flight next year.
The first zero-gravity dance studio, "AstroGroove," opened in September 2024 and was founded by former ballet dancer and aeronautics engineer Maria Gomez.
Special suits called "GyroGears," fitted with gyroscopes and stabilizers, help dancers control their movements in weightlessness.
In November 2024, the International Space Arts Federation launched the inaugural "Ad Astra Dance Challenge," held aboard zero-gravity simulation chambers.
VR set-ups that simulate zero-gravity dance offer a safe, accessible alternative for people with a headset.
Mikhail Chen's "Lunar Moves" academy in Los Angeles has offered zero-gravity dance modules since January 2025.
Mikhail Chen calls the dance "symbolic" of humanity's aspirational nature and pursuit of pushing boundaries.
On February 15, 2025, the National Academy of Performing Arts announced it would include zero-gravity dance in its syllabus.
The trend is renewing interest in STEM, as dance students study the physics of motion and space travel.
